gui.skyabyss.domain.stone_sea.goal: Strike the resonant bones in the order they sounded
gui.skyabyss.domain.shell_match.goal: Strike every panel that matches the mark above the heart
gui.skyabyss.domain.thunder_cage.goal: Strike the charged rod to ground the lightning
gui.skyabyss.domain.hearth_core.goal: Crouch beside the ember cores to quench them
message.skyabyss.domain.invulnerable: The heart cannot be hurt during its domain. Solve the puzzle
message.skyabyss.domain.stone_sea.goal: Three bones are ringing on their own. Strike them back in the order they sounded (left or right click)
message.skyabyss.domain.shell_match.goal: Shell panels lie on the floor. Strike every panel bearing the mark floating above the heart (left or right click). A wrong panel puts the lit ones out
message.skyabyss.domain.shell_match.wron: Wrong panel. The lit ones went out
message.skyabyss.domain.thunder_cage.goa: The lightning rods charge one at a time. Strike the brightly glowing rod before it fills
message.skyabyss.domain.hearth_core.goal: Three ember cores burn. Crouch beside each to quench it. It warms again if you leave
gui.skyabyss.trial.title: Titan Shrine
gui.skyabyss.trial.codex.empty: Trials you have not seen keep their names hidden
gui.skyabyss.trial.help: Each cycle draws one trial from Walk, Wit and Fight
message.skyabyss.trial.board_far: The shrine is too far. Open it beside the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.stone_not_yours: This is another party's trial goal
message.skyabyss.trial.first: First time through %s. Added to the codex
message.skyabyss.trial.title: Title earned
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.start: Strike the ribs back in the order shown on the wall. A mistake starts over
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.recall: Press the lectern to see the score again for a moment
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.solved: The score falls silent. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.start: Three of the four handles are alive. Open all three sluices within the grace time and hold. %s weight stones
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.opened: All three sluices are open. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.flooded: This handle is flooded and does nothing now
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.pulled: A sluice is open. Open the rest within %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w10.start: Run from cover to cover and bring down the gunners on the rise. Read the cannon telegraph
message.skyabyss.trial.w10.cleared: The gunners are down. The door before the stone opens
trial.skyabyss.cell.W01.desc: Cross the rib valley on crumbling bone footing.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W05.desc: Carry light sprouts through dark waterways and light the stands.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W09.desc: Hold out against waves of sentinels in a sealing hall.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T01.desc: Carry a pearl to the altar during the ebb.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T05.desc: Move the water level to climb to the ledge.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T09.desc: Break three nests and fell the Tide Caller.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S01.desc: Climb the bone with updrafts and gliding rings.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S05.desc: Route lightning with wires and levers to the door pillar.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S06.desc: Bend light with feather mirrors onto three receivers.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E01.desc: Scatter ash to make a cooled crust path over lava.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E05.desc: Forge the fire key at the great furnace.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E09.desc: Tend the hearth fire and keep it burning.
message.skyabyss.trial.w03.start: The moss flows toward the lit wall. Rest on bone islands, read the current, and cross to the next one
message.skyabyss.trial.w03.fell: You fell into the gap. Back to the last island you stood on
message.skyabyss.trial.w03.crossed: You reached the bottom of the slope. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.start: A vent pad flickers white, then blows. Ride the blasts up the ledges to the south exit. The drop into the shaft is gentle
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.plugged: Plug pad pressed. Every blast lasts longer
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.back_down: Back at the bottom. Wait for the next blast
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.reached: You reached the exit ledge. The gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w11.start: The coffin moves while someone stands near it, but not while foes surround it. Split into pushers and guards and bring it to the altar
message.skyabyss.trial.w11.broken: The coffin broke. Back to where the last pack came
message.skyabyss.trial.w11.arrived: The coffin reached the altar. The far gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w12.start: Beat three waves. The floor falls away after each one. Cracked tiles go first
message.skyabyss.trial.w12.cleared: The arena is yours. The exit bridge appears
message.skyabyss.trial.w12.fell: You fell out of the arena. Back to the foyer
message.skyabyss.trial.t02.start: Sandbars at the ebb, floating stones at the flood; the two paths overlap at the turn. Stones sink if you linger. Reach the far shore
message.skyabyss.trial.t02.crossed: You reached the far shore. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.t02.splash: You fell in. Swim back to a shore or a path
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.start: Strike the seven shells in the order of the mural's colours. Three choruses. A wrong shell clouds the sea
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.rule0: First chorus: the top row, left to right
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.rule1: Second chorus: the bottom row, right to left
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.rule2: Third chorus: top and bottom rows, alternating from the left
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.murk: The sea clouded. This chorus starts over
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.recalled: The mural surfaces for a while
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.recall_coolin: The lectern is still cooling. %s s left
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.solved: The chorus is done. The far gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.start: Move the two seas with the three plugs and match the gold marks at once (A %s / B %s). Hold them. The white plug resets
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.blocked: It will not move further (A %s, B %s)
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.hold: On the marks. Hold for %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.solved: The seas agree. The far gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.start: Beat three waves. The tide rises each time and washes the island away, sand first, sandstone later
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.cleared: The ring is yours. The exit bridge appears
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.fell: You sank deep. Back to the foyer
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.wet: You are in the water. Get back onto a foothold
message.skyabyss.trial.e02.start: A glowing crack bursts a moment later. Pick quiet lanes and cross the bands. Ash pools cool you.
message.skyabyss.trial.e02.crossed: Across. You can ring the stone.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.rule.first: Smoke leans toward the true flue, which rises straight. Right-click the straight chimney.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.rule.decoy: Dead air also rises straight. The true flue is where the rest lean.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.rule.away: Headwind room: smoke flees from the true flue. Look opposite to the lean.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.right: The true flue (%s / %s). On to the next room.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.done: The furnace door opened. You can ring the stone.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.decoy: Dead air. A blast of heat.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.gust_warn: A gust comes. The smoke will scatter.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.gust_now: The smoke is scattered. Wait for it to settle.
message.skyabyss.trial.e06.locked: The lids are still hot. %s s left.
message.skyabyss.trial.e07.start: Stand on a pad to fan its fire; it lingers a while. Keep every flame lit at once to open the furnace. %s weight stones (sneak + click a pad).
message.skyabyss.trial.e07.stage2: The first mouth opened. Now %s pads (cracked bellows lose fire fast).
message.skyabyss.trial.e07.done: All furnace mouths are open. The far door opens.
message.skyabyss.trial.e07.dormant: This pad is not in use yet
message.skyabyss.trial.e07.step: Stand on a pad. Sneak + click to set a weight stone (%s).
message.skyabyss.trial.e07.ashed: This pad is buried in ash
message.skyabyss.trial.e10.start: Fell the bearers. While they live the hall keeps heating. Cool off on the ash pools by the walls.
message.skyabyss.trial.e10.cleared: The furnace calmed. You can ring the stone.
message.skyabyss.trial.s02.start: A sac blows an updraft only while inflated. Stand in the middle of a lit sac, rise, then sneak to glide to the next
message.skyabyss.trial.s02.feather: You received a gale feather. Sneak in the air to glide
message.skyabyss.trial.s02.fell: You fell. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.s02.crossed: You reached the far deck. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s03.start: Orange tiles get struck a moment later. Gold tiles are safe. Lightning runs from pillar to pillar
message.skyabyss.trial.s03.fell: You fell from a pillar. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.s03.crossed: You reached the far deck. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s09.start: Rings near a rod fall on the rod. A rod that caught three rings discharges. Defeat the callers
message.skyabyss.trial.s09.overload: A rod is full and about to discharge. Move away
message.skyabyss.trial.s09.fell: You fell from the nest. Back to the foyer
message.skyabyss.trial.s09.occupied: Another party is using the nest. Wait in the foyer
message.skyabyss.trial.s09.peaceful: The fight does not begin on Peaceful
message.skyabyss.trial.s09.wave_done: Wave cleared. Brace for the next
message.skyabyss.trial.s09.cleared: The callers are beaten. The east bridge opens. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s10.start: Beat a post's guards to wake its wind vent. Rise on the vent and glide to the next post
message.skyabyss.trial.s10.feather: You received a gale feather. Sneak in the air to glide
message.skyabyss.trial.s10.fell: You fell from a post. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.s10.quiet: No guards here. The wind vent is awake
message.skyabyss.trial.s10.cleared_platf: Guards beaten. The wind vent is awake
message.skyabyss.trial.s10.cleared: The last post is yours. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.weekly_stone_rung: You have already finished this trial
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.start: Move lamps and pillars so the shadow on the wall matches the mark above. The panels are under the north wall (lamps right, pillars left). Hold the match for 2 s
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.rule0: A pillar between lamp and wall casts a shadow. Lamp right, shadow left; pillar right, shadow right (twice as far)
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.rule1: Two lamps. Only where both lights are blocked is it dark (the overlap of two shadows)
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.rule2: More lamps and pillars. The mark depends on overlap and spacing. Check with the light beams
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.rule3: One more screen. Split up: lamp mover, pillar mover, watcher
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.hold: The shadow matches. Hold it for %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.solved: The shadow play is set. The east door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.unused: This panel is unused for this screen
message.skyabyss.trial.w08.draft_warn: The lamps flicker. A draft will shove one
message.skyabyss.trial.t03.start: A bell sinks while you stand on it. Keep moving. After the rest isle, pink-swelling tentacle rows sweep the cave
message.skyabyss.trial.t03.splash: You fell in. Swim back to a bell or the shore
message.skyabyss.trial.t03.crossed: Across the cave. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t04.start: Ride the current. At each fork only the green-floored lane flows forward; red pushes you back. Hop lanes through the divider windows. Valves lock the flow
message.skyabyss.trial.t04.washed: Washed back. Pick the forward lane again from the pool
message.skyabyss.trial.t04.landed: Out of the slide. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.start: Sort the coral pieces on the rack into the bowls by the plaques' rule. Right-click a piece to pick it up, a bowl to drop it in. The lectern shows the plaques again
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.rule0: The plaques show colour. Drop a piece in the bowl of its colour
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.rule1: The plaques show height (stack size). Ignore colour. Match the height
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.rule2: The plaques show colour and height. Both must match. If none does, use the black-plaque cracked bowl
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.wrong: Wrong bowl. The piece goes back to the rack and the sea clouds over
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.returned: Returned the piece to the rack
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.hands_full: You already hold one. Drop it in a bowl or put it in an empty slot
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.empty_hands: You are not holding a piece
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.no_cracked: This round has no cracked bowl
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.recalled: The plaques show again for a while
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.recall_coolin: %s s until you can look again
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.swap_warn: The plaques flicker. The tide will swap them
message.skyabyss.trial.t08.solved: The specimens are sorted. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t11.start: Stand ahead of the clam (within 4.5 blocks) and it follows. Swarms pin it in place. Split into leader and guards and reach the shrine before the tide rises
message.skyabyss.trial.t11.pelted: The clam is being pelted with bubbles. Sturdiness %s%%
message.skyabyss.trial.t11.broken: The clam cracked. Restart from where the last swarm came
message.skyabyss.trial.t11.rising: The tide is coming in. Hurry
message.skyabyss.trial.t11.flooded: The tide rose. The clam drifted back to where the last swarm came
message.skyabyss.trial.t11.arrived: The clam reached the shrine. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.start: Trial of the Pearl Keeper. Step toward the middle of the hall to begin. The keeper's moves come after floor markings
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.engage: The keeper rose from its shell
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.curtain: A curtain fell. Only those inside face the keeper (a small stage)
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.full: The whole hall is the stage
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.moves0: It starts with updrafts and bubble volleys. After a move, the keeper is winded
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.moves1: It starts with shell charges and downdraft rings. After a move, the keeper is winded
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.brood: It shelled up. A brood appears (shell %s, %s foes). The brood goes for the pearl
message.skyabyss.trial.t12.defeated: The keeper is beaten. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.e03.start: Cross west. Standing still heats a plank red, and a red plank burns. A fall returns you to your last plank
message.skyabyss.trial.e03.fell: Burned or fell. Back to your last plank
message.skyabyss.trial.e03.crossed: You reached the far bank. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.e04.start: Take the coal from the stone and carry it to the far hearth. Water puts it out
message.skyabyss.trial.e04.taken: You took the coal. Heat builds while you carry it
message.skyabyss.trial.e04.held: Someone is already carrying the coal
message.skyabyss.trial.e04.gust_warn: Wind is coming. Crouch, or stand near an ally
message.skyabyss.trial.e04.doused: The coal went out. Take a new one from the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.e04.reached: The coal reached the hearth. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.e08.start: The spout shows the colours in order. Remember them and pour into the matching mould
message.skyabyss.trial.e08.wait_show: The display is still running. Pour after it ends
message.skyabyss.trial.e08.wrong: Wrong mould. Heat rises and the display starts over
message.skyabyss.trial.e11.start: Stand near the cart to push it. Foes near it wear it down. Beat the raids and reach the furnace
message.skyabyss.trial.e11.broken: The cart broke. Back to the last raid
message.skyabyss.trial.e11.arrived: The cart reached the furnace. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.e12.start: Ember bugs roll out of the holes. A curled bug is hard. Strike it once it dizzies on a wall
message.skyabyss.trial.e12.cleared: The nest is quiet. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s04.start: Before a gust, feathers stream downwind and the lee floor of each pillar glows white. Stand in the glow to be safe. The first bridge's wind always blows from the north
message.skyabyss.trial.s04.twist: From here the wind changes each time. Watch the feathers and the glowing lee
message.skyabyss.trial.s04.fell: You fell off the bridge. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.s04.crossed: You reached the far deck. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s07.start: Right-click a mirror to flip it. The beam bends at mirrors. Fix room 1 so the beam strikes the window
message.skyabyss.trial.s07.window: The window opens. Mirrors on same-colored pedestals are linked: flipping one flips the other
message.skyabyss.trial.s07.hold: The catcher is lit. Hold it for %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.s07.cleared: The beam reached the catcher. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s07.fell: You fell. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.s08.start: Right-click a valve: sac pressure moves as its wall panel shows (green +1, red -1). Sneak to turn back. Match the gold marks and hold
message.skyabyss.trial.s08.stuck: It won't turn further (pressure would leave 0-5)
message.skyabyss.trial.s08.stage2: Sacs C and D wake. The third valve turns, and valves now affect C and D too
message.skyabyss.trial.s11.start: The cage follows its path while someone is within 7 blocks. Lightning strikes the cage: stay 3+ blocks away and guard it
message.skyabyss.trial.s11.rule: Lightning will strike the cage. Get out of the ring around it
message.skyabyss.trial.s11.raid: Raid (%s / %s). Lure foes next to the cage so the lightning hits them
message.skyabyss.trial.s11.broken: The cage broke. Restarting from the last raid
message.skyabyss.trial.s11.arrived: The cage reached the tower. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s11.fell: You fell off the deck. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.s12.start: Pads are carried away half at a time and return. Yellow flicker = leaving soon. Orange pads get a feather storm. The core is safe from storms
message.skyabyss.trial.s12.support: The Warden Chief calls its retinue
message.skyabyss.trial.s12.storm: A feather storm is coming. Leave the orange pad
message.skyabyss.trial.s12.cleared: The Warden Chief falls. The pads return and the exit bridge opens. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.s12.fell: You fell off the summit. Back to the foyer
message.skyabyss.trial.s12.peaceful: The fight does not begin on Peaceful
message.skyabyss.trial.s12.reset: Nobody is left on the summit. Starting over
message.skyabyss.route.waiting: Waiting for the party (%s/%s). The trial starts when everyone is at the entrance
message.skyabyss.route.heart: Three trials crossed. Beyond the seal, the heartbeat waits.
message.skyabyss.route.abandon_pending: Still waiting for the answer to abandon
message.skyabyss.route.abandon_cooldown: You can propose to abandon again in %s s
message.skyabyss.route.abandon_none: There is no proposal to abandon right now
message.skyabyss.route.abandoned: The route is abandoned. The back pushes the party out.
message.skyabyss.route.use_shrine: Replays of this back begin at the titan's shrine on the ground
item.skyabyss.song_shard_stone_whale.des: Use one at the Stone Whale shrine to be called onto its route
item.skyabyss.song_shard_tide_shell.desc: Use one at the Tide Shell shrine to be called onto its route
item.skyabyss.song_shard_thunder_wing.de: Use one at the Thunder Wing shrine to be called onto its route
item.skyabyss.song_shard_ember.desc: Use one at the Ember shrine to be called onto its route
gui.skyabyss.shrine.craft_tip: The shrine forge makes one song shard from %s of this titan's material and %s resonance shards
message.skyabyss.shrine.unknown: You have not stopped this titan's heart yet. The shrine opens after that
message.skyabyss.shrine.member_unknown: %s has not stopped this titan's heart yet
message.skyabyss.shrine.no_shard: Hold %s and keep touching the stele
message.skyabyss.shrine.busy: Your route is already under way
message.skyabyss.shrine.no_back: The titan's back cannot be reached yet
message.skyabyss.shrine.filling: The titan's song rises from below %s
message.skyabyss.shrine.song: The titan's song rises from beneath your feet.
message.skyabyss.shrine.left_behind: %s were called onto the route. You were outside the ring and stayed behind
message.skyabyss.shrine.guarded: The shrine's pedestal cannot be broken
message.skyabyss.shrine.craft_far: Shards are made beside the shrine of a titan whose heart you stilled
message.skyabyss.vow.closed.shrine: Vows are chosen beside the titan's shrine
objective.skyabyss.route_carrying: Soon you are carried on to %s
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR1.1: The orb is faintly warm. A remnant of some light this whale swallowed long ago?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR1.2: The people of the back must have carried these too, along their pilgrim road.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR2.1: The bones are ringing, though there is no wind.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR2.2: The beat seems to come from far below my feet.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR3.1: The core is pulsing. Is this what the sentries guarded?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR3.2: Did they mean to give this heartbeat back to someone, someday?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR4.1: Only fluid rises through a body that does not breathe.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR4.2: The bone steps were laid by hand. The people of the back climbed here too.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR5.1: A floor of bones is searching for a single shape.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR5.2: Maybe the whale still remembers how its own bones were laid.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR6.1: The edge of the ring is turning red. Maybe it is not the floor that is shrinking, but the beat.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR6.2: What did the sentries guard to the end, inside this narrowing ring?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR1.1: Inside the pearl, a light pulses slowly.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR1.2: Did they gather them here instead of giving them back to the tide?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR2.1: The shells sound like the tide coming in and going out.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR2.2: The pull of the moon reaches all the way inside the shell.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR3.1: The people of the back are gone, yet something still guards this place.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR3.2: Someone planted these saplings and left them behind.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR4.1: The coral branches reach out and draw back, as if making way for someone.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR4.2: Perhaps it was not the tide people who made this road, but the coral itself.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR5.1: The face of the pearl gives back a faint light.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR5.2: Were the people here waiting for someone to return the stored light to?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR6.1: The moons on the wall wax, wane, and wax again.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR6.2: The people of the back seem to have counted the tide by the shape of the moon.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR7.1: The brood mother keeps what look like shadows of herself.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR7.2: Only what is left at the feet tells the real from the false.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR1.1: The feather is light. Wind runs through the bones.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR1.2: Perhaps the wind folk learned to fly inside these bones.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR2.1: Copper lines pass the lightning from pillar to pillar.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR2.2: A remnant of the days when the pillars protected the people?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR3.1: Perhaps this storm is a cloak the bird wears.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR3.2: What is it hiding from? ...The shadow above?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER1.1: The ember cools even as you hold it.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER1.2: Cooled blood crumbles. This mountain too, someday.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER2.1: The smith in the mural is hammering something small.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER2.2: Was the key forged at a furnace like this one?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER3.1: When the furnace fire thins, the floor sinks a little.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER3.2: If the fire dies out, will the titan sleep?
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_raid_: On the wall of the resting place at the entrance to the chain road. Those who dropped the bridge behind them seem never to have looked back.
Carved at the entrance to the valve room. It seems the forge ran on four breaths.
At the entrance to the pupils' hall, on the wall of the resting place. Before the smith there were those who never became smiths.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER4.1: The chains holding this bridge are still bright. Someone crossed here not long ago.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER4.2: You only cut the road behind you when something is chasing you. What were they running from?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER5.1: The valve wheels are worn smooth where hands turned them, again and again.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER5.2: Four breaths made into one. Maybe even the forge could not breathe alone.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER6.1: Four lamps on the wall. Is that how many pupils were taught here? Maybe the smith was one of them.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER6.2: Every pupil stands with the same master's habits. The more you cut down, the closer the master's face comes.
